extension.name: VM Payment - NakoPay
extension.author: NakoPay
extension.description: Accept Bitcoin payments on VirtueMart via NakoPay. Non-custodial, 1% flat fee, direct-to-wallet settlement.

field.name: nakopay_api_key
field.label: API Key
field.description: Your NakoPay secret key (sk_test_* or sk_live_*)

field.name: nakopay_webhook_secret
field.label: Webhook Secret
field.description: Used to verify incoming webhook signatures (whsec_*)

field.name: nakopay_sandbox
field.label: Sandbox Mode
field.description: Enable to test without real funds

field.name: status_pending
field.label: Pending Status
field.description: Order status when invoice is created

field.name: status_success
field.label: Success Status
field.description: Order status when payment is confirmed
